source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Occupational Outlook Handbook + Employment Projections 2024–2034

occupations.title: Software developers
occupations.notes: Includes QA analysts and testers under combined OEWS coverage; 5x all-occupations average.

occupations.title: Information security analysts
occupations.notes: Strongest growth rate of any role in this analysis.

occupations.title: Software quality assurance analysts and testers
occupations.notes: Aggregate hides bifurcation: SDET/test-infra growing, manual QA shrinking.

occupations.title: Data scientists
occupations.notes: Aggregate strongly up but bucket re-labeled — much of the growth lands in ML Eng titles in industry.

occupations.title: Network and computer systems administrators
occupations.notes: Flat — automation pressure on traditional sysadmin work.

occupations.title: Web developers
occupations.notes: BLS aggregate masks frontend compression — junior web-dev roles dropping fastest.

occupations.title: Computer user support specialists
occupations.notes: Front-line IT support — flat-to-modest growth despite AI deflection.

occupations.title: Computer occupations, all other (incl. cloud, ML, MLOps)
occupations.notes: Catch-all bucket where Cloud, ML, MLOps, Platform engineers land in BLS taxonomy.
